description: This file defines a custom JSP tag class StoreBreadcrumbsTag used to generate breadcrumb navigation URLs in a web application. It manages breadcrumb references based on category and product IDs and outputs a URL string.

classes.name: StoreBreadcrumbsTag
classes.description: A custom JSP tag class that generates breadcrumb URL content based on category and product IDs, and the current breadcrumb state.

methods.name: doStartTag
methods.description: Generates and outputs the breadcrumb URL string based on request attributes and internal state.

methods.name: parseBreadCrumb
methods.description: Parses breadcrumb reference content into a list of category ID strings.

methods.name: doEndTag
methods.description: Indicates the end of tag processing, returning evaluation directive.
